question: The ______ National Voters' Day was celebrated across the country on 25th January 2023, with President of India Droupadi Murmu gracing the national level event held at New Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**13th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 13th National Voters' Day was celebrated on 25th January 2023.**
 
• National Voters' Day is celebrated to encourage more people to participate in the electoral process and create awareness about the importance of voting.
 
• President of India Droupadi Murmu graced the national-level event held at New Delhi to mark the occasion.
 
• **The theme for the 13th National Voters' Day was "**Nothing Like Voting, I Vote for Sure**".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **12th** National Voters' Day was celebrated on 25th January 2022.

 
 
• **The theme is "Making Elections Inclusive, Accessible and Participative****".**
 
 
 
• The **10th **National Voters' Day was celebrated on 25th January 2020.
 
 
• **The theme is "Electoral Literacy for Stronger Democracy".**
 
 
 
• The **11th** National Voters' Day was celebrated on 25th January 2021.
 
 
• **The theme is "Making Our Voters Empowered, Vigilant, Safe, and Informed".**
